text:
Lina K: Hey team — got an invoice from VitalGrid, but the PO scanner failed. Attachment is a set of screenshots (PNG). PO number is visible in the image but OCR returned garbage. Need someone to manually match or ask vendor for a proper PDF.

Raj Patel: Can you drop the invoice number and PO here? I'll try a manual match first.

Lina K: Invoice INV-2026-842, total $12,450.00, PO shows as PO-789012 (but embedded in image). Attached: vitalgrid_invoice_842.png

finance-bot: Automated note: incoming invoice INV-2026-842 flagged for "attachment unreadable". No PO matched in the system. Suggested action: manual match or request reissue.

Amir S: Ugh. If the PO # is legible we can manually link in ProcureLink. Steps: open PO, click "Attach invoice" -> upload -> confirm lines. If it's blurry, ask for reissue.

vitalgrid-billing: Hi Lina — thanks for flagging. We can reissue as a single-page PDF. We originally pulled screenshots because the customer portal timed out. Can we keep the same invoice number? Also, do you need any GL or cost center changes?

Lina K: Yes please keep same invoice number. We need GL to be 5601-CloudInfra and cost center CC-310. Also we need the invoice to include the PO in text (not image) so OCR picks it up.

Raj Patel: I'll try manual link now. If ProcureLink rejects due to format, we'll ask vendor to reissue PDF. Tagging AP queue. @Amir S can you stand by for GL code confirmation?

Amir S: Confirmed GL 5601-CloudInfra and CC-310. OK for me.

Raj Patel: Quick note of commands I used to attach: ```1) Open ProcureLink -> PO PO-789012 -> Attach invoice -> select vitalgrid_invoice_842.png -> Save. 2) In AP console, mark invoice as "manual-match".``` It accepted the attachment but the OCR fields remain empty (no PO parsed) so invoice is in a manual review state.

finance-bot: Action recorded: INV-2026-842 set to manual_review. Assigned to AP team (queue: ap-manual-matches). Due date for match: 3 business days (2064029600).

Lina K: Thanks Raj. I'll ping VitalGrid to reissue as requested and mark the ticket with GL/CC info. VitalGrid — pls upload PDF to the portal and paste the link here when done.

vitalgrid-billing: Will do, reissue ETA: today EOD UTC. We'll post link once uploaded. Sorry for the extra work. :pray:

Raj Patel: Great. Leaving comment on the PO: "awaiting vendor PDF for OCR; invoice temporarily manual-matched". Closing loop here for now.

Lina K: Marking this thread resolved on our side after vendor reissue. Will update if any mismatch after re-upload. :white_check_mark:
